academic_sessions_dates.name: academic_sessions_dates
academic_sessions_dates.value: ends_on IS NULL OR starts_on IS NULL OR ends_on > starts_on

grade_bands_range.name: grade_bands_range
grade_bands_range.value: min_score >= 0 AND min_score <= max_score AND max_score <= 100

grading_policies_maxima.name: grading_policies_maxima
grading_policies_maxima.value: ca_max > 0 AND exam_max > 0 AND ca_max + exam_max = 100

terms_dates.name: terms_dates
terms_dates.value: ends_on IS NULL OR starts_on IS NULL OR ends_on > starts_on

enrollments_dates.name: enrollments_dates
enrollments_dates.value: ended_on IS NULL OR enrolled_on IS NULL OR ended_on >= enrolled_on

student_identifiers_parts.name: student_identifiers_parts
student_identifiers_parts.value:
(level_code IS NULL AND year IS NULL AND serial IS NULL)
        OR (level_code IS NOT NULL AND year IS NOT NULL AND serial > 0)

result_publications_published_at.name: result_publications_published_at
result_publications_published_at.value: NOT is_published OR published_at IS NOT NULL

generated.as: CASE WHEN ca IS NOT NULL AND exam IS NOT NULL THEN ca + exam END

result_scores_ca_range.name: result_scores_ca_range
result_scores_ca_range.value: ca IS NULL OR ca BETWEEN 0 AND 100

result_scores_exam_range.name: result_scores_exam_range
result_scores_exam_range.value: exam IS NULL OR exam BETWEEN 0 AND 100

fee_charges_void_consistent.name: fee_charges_void_consistent
fee_charges_void_consistent.value: (status = 'voided') = (voided_at IS NOT NULL AND void_reason IS NOT NULL)

fee_charges_creator.name: fee_charges_creator
fee_charges_creator.value: created_by_id IS NOT NULL OR source = 'v1_import'

payments_void_consistent.name: payments_void_consistent
payments_void_consistent.value: (status = 'voided') = (voided_at IS NOT NULL AND void_reason IS NOT NULL)

payments_v2_complete.name: payments_v2_complete
payments_v2_complete.value: source = 'v1_import' OR (receipt_number IS NOT NULL AND paid_on IS NOT NULL AND method IS NOT NULL AND recorded_by_id IS NOT NULL)

audit_logs_actor_consistent.name: audit_logs_actor_consistent
audit_logs_actor_consistent.value:
(actor_type = 'staff' AND actor_user_id IS NOT NULL AND actor_student_id IS NULL)
        OR (actor_type = 'student' AND actor_student_id IS NOT NULL AND actor_user_id IS NULL)
        OR (actor_type = 'system' AND actor_user_id IS NULL AND actor_student_id IS NULL)
